NaturalMeaning: to make use of; take advantage of
Context: Commonly used when making good use of time, an opportunity, or a resource.

Grammar.function: use an opportunity or situation to do something

Usage: A high-frequency verb used for opportunities, time, resources, and favorable situations.
Pronunciation: Stress falls on the final syllable.
NaturalSpeech: Inside a sentence, keep the verb inside the surrounding rhythmic group rather than isolating it.
Example: Voy a aprovechar el fin de semana para descansar.
